nodes.label: UI/UX Pro Max skill
nodes.rationale: UI/UX design intelligence for web, mobile, and desktop. Used when designing, building, reviewing, or fixing interfaces including pages, components, design systems, accessibility, interaction, responsive layout, typography, color, charts, and stack-specific UI implementation. Searchable local data: 79 searchable styles (50 active), 192 product palettes and reasoning profiles, 74 font pairings, 119 UX guidelines, 105 icons, 17 GSAP presets, 25 chart types, and 22 stacks.

nodes.label: Accessibility (CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: CRITICAL priority. Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text (3:1 large text); visible focus rings (2-4px); descriptive alt text; aria-label for icon-only buttons; keyboard nav matching visual order; skip links; sequential heading hierarchy h1-h6; don't convey info by color alone; respect prefers-reduced-motion; WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA criteria (focus-not-obscured, focus-appearance, dragging-alternative, web-target-size, consistent-help, redundant-entry, accessible-authentication, auto-rotation-controls, contextual-live-badge-updates).

nodes.label: Touch & Interaction (CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: CRITICAL priority. Min touch target 44x44pt (Apple) / 48x48dp (Material); 8px+ gap between touch targets; click/tap over hover; loading buttons with spinner; error feedback near problem; touch-action manipulation; platform standard gestures; haptic feedback; safe-area awareness; no pixel-perfect taps.

nodes.label: Performance (HIGH)
nodes.rationale: HIGH priority. WebP/AVIF, lazy loading, reserve space (CLS < 0.1); font-display swap/optional; critical CSS; lazy load non-hero components; bundle splitting by route/feature; third-party scripts async/defer; virtualize lists 50+ items; main-thread budget ~16ms for 60fps; skeleton screens; input latency <100ms; debounce/throttle; offline support.

nodes.label: Style Selection (HIGH)
nodes.rationale: HIGH priority. Match style to product type; consistency across pages; SVG icons not emoji; palette from product/industry; effects aligned with style; platform-adaptive idioms (iOS HIG vs Material); state clarity; consistent elevation/shadow scale; dark mode pairing; one icon set/visual language; native/system controls; blur for background dismissal; one primary CTA per screen.

nodes.label: Layout & Responsive (HIGH)
nodes.rationale: HIGH priority. viewport meta width=device-width initial-scale=1; mobile-first; systematic breakpoints (375/768/1024/1440); min 16px body text; line length 35-60 mobile / 60-75 desktop; no horizontal scroll; 4pt/8dp spacing system; consistent max-width desktop; z-index scale; viewport units min-h-dvh; visual hierarchy via size/spacing/contrast.

nodes.label: Typography & Color (MEDIUM)
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM priority. Line-height 1.5-1.75; line length 65-75 chars; font pairing; consistent type scale; darker text on light backgrounds; semantic color tokens (primary, secondary, error, surface, on-surface) not raw hex; dark mode desaturated/lighter tonal variants; 4.5:1 AA / 7:1 AAA contrast pairs; functional color needs icon/text; tabular figures for data columns.

nodes.label: Animation (MEDIUM)
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM priority. Shared motion tokens by distance/complexity; transform/opacity only; animate 1-2 key elements per view; deceleration arriving / acceleration leaving; motion must express cause-effect; smooth state transitions; spatial continuity; spring/physics curves; exit faster than enter (~60-70%); stagger 30-50ms; shared element transitions; interruptible; no blocking input; crossfade content replacement.

nodes.label: Forms & Feedback (MEDIUM)
nodes.rationale: MEDIUM priority. Visible labels per input; error below field with aria-describedby; loading then success/error on submit; required indicators; empty states; toast auto-dismiss 3-5s; confirm destructive actions; helper text; disabled reduced opacity 0.38-0.5; progressive disclosure; validate on blur; semantic input types; password toggle; autocomplete; undo support; success feedback; error recovery cause+fix; multi-step progress; form autosave; focus management; error summary.

nodes.label: Navigation Patterns (HIGH)
nodes.rationale: HIGH priority. Bottom nav max 5 items with labels; drawer for secondary nav; predictable back behavior; deep linking; iOS bottom Tab Bar; Android Top App Bar; icon+label nav items; current location highlighted; primary vs secondary nav separated; modal close affordance; search reachable; breadcrumbs 3+ level; state preservation; system gesture support; badges sparingly; overflow menu; bottom nav top-level only; sidebar large screens; no stack reset; navigation consistency; no mixed patterns; modals not for primary navigation; focus on route change; persistent nav; destructive nav separation; empty nav state.

nodes.label: Charts & Data (LOW)
nodes.rationale: LOW priority. Match chart type to data; accessible palettes no red/green only; table alternative; patterns/textures supplement color; visible legend; tooltips on interact; axis labels with units; responsive chart; empty data state; skeleton loading; animation respects reduced-motion; aggregate/sample 1000+ points; locale-aware formatting; >=44pt tap area; no pie >5 categories; >=3:1 data vs background, >=4.5:1 data text; clickable legends; direct labeling; keyboard-reachable tooltips; sortable tables; subtle gridlines; limit data density; emphasize trends; focusable chart elements; screen-reader summary; error state with retry; CSV/image export; drill-down back path; time scale clarity.

nodes.label: WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines)
nodes.rationale: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines; AA criterion 4.5:1 text contrast, AAA 7:1; WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA criteria referenced throughout accessibility section (focus-not-obscured, focus-appearance, dragging-alternative, web-target-size, consistent-help, redundant-entry, accessible-authentication, auto-rotation-controls, contextual-live-badge-updates).

nodes.label: Apple Human Interface Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Apple Human Interface Guidelines; referenced for focus rings, keyboard nav, accessibilityLabel, Dynamic Type, Reduced Motion API, VoiceOver, escape routes, shortcuts, press feedback, haptic, safe areas, standard gestures, blur, primary action, continuity, parallax, spring physics, interruptible, no blocking input, scale feedback, gesture feedback, hierarchy motion, modal motion, navigation direction, tab bar, drawer.

nodes.label: Material Design
nodes.rationale: Material Design; referenced for contrast, touch targets 48dp, touch spacing 8dp, state layers, elevation, color system, type roles, motion, loading buttons, inline validation, input helper text, disabled states, password toggle, autofill, toast, error recovery, multi-step progress, field grouping, read-only distinction, nav label icon, nav state active, nav hierarchy, search accessible, breadcrumbs, tab badge, overflow menu, bottom nav top level, adaptive navigation, destructive nav separation, empty nav state, legend interactive, sortable tables, axis readability.

nodes.label: Phosphor Icons
nodes.rationale: Default icon library (@phosphor-icons/react); preferred over Heroicons when available; common recommended icons listed in src/ui-ux-pro-max/data/icons.csv (not complete set).

nodes.label: Heroicons
nodes.rationale: Fallback icon library (@heroicons/react) when Phosphor lacks an ideal option; maintain style consistency (stroke width, corner radius, filled vs outline).

nodes.label: GSAP animation
nodes.rationale: GSAP animation skeletons by intensity tier (scroll reveal, stagger, magnetic cursor, page transition); --motion dial attaches ready-to-use GSAP snippet matched to Subtle/Standard/Complex tier.

nodes.label: Semantic color tokens / design tokens
nodes.rationale: Semantic color tokens (primary, secondary, error, surface, on-surface) not raw hex in components; token-driven theming mapped per theme across app surfaces/text/icons; --space-* CSS variable table overridden by --density dial.

nodes.label: Design System (Master + Overrides)
nodes.rationale: Master + Overrides pattern: design-system/<project-slug>/MASTER.md global source of truth; design-system/<project-slug>/pages/<page-name>.md page-specific overrides; page rules override Master when present; hierarchical retrieval across sessions via --persist.
